subject: [PATCH v3 6/7] mm: use BIT() for change_protection() flags

reviews.author: David Hildenbrand (Arm)
reviews.summary: Acknowledged the patch and applied his Acked-by tag.

2026-09-22.patch_summary: This patch series aims to modernize the change_protection() flags in the Linux kernel by using the BIT() macro consistently for all flags, replacing open-coded shifts.
